cohort: The study included 663,795 women between the ages of 20 and 44 who had a maternal admission code in the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) data from 2012 to 2017.
finding: Women with a history of WLS had significantly lower odds of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, and cesarean delivery compared to women with obesity who did not undergo WLS, with results mediated by race.
mod_finding: Women with a history of WLS had lower odds of cesarean delivery compared to women who did not have WLS.
